title: Rocket Ready ABC
hook: One system hands the mission to the next.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of silence before confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D preschool rockets-and-astronauts storybook, white-blue-orange palette, friendly suits, simple clean silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading a simplified systems-engineering checklist
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written function-first engineering lines plus honest astronomy context
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: system cue -> recall beat -> target -> function/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a dry mission-control click or light tom punctuation after each confirmed target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a dry mission-control click or light tom punctuation after each confirmed target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Rocket Ready an engineering checklist: communication, launch propulsion, tanks, capsule, observatory/science payload, rover and electric thruster each have a job; celestial targets are mission destinations or observations.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Mission Control reads subsystem by subsystem—structure, communication, propulsion, payload, destination—without pretending every space word belongs on one rocket.
semanticArc: separate mission targets from vehicle systems
